records.name: Shape
records.tagline: The agentic IDE for designers and programmers
records.description: Shape is the agentic IDE for designers and programmers. Design, code, Git, and AI chat in one desktop app. Download for Windows.

records.name: Prized
records.tagline: Let non-engineers build secure internal tools
records.description: Prized lets ops, support, and finance teams build and ship secure internal tools with AI. Company data pre-connected and scoped, an audit trail on every access, one-click deploy behind your company sign-in.

records.name: Checksum AI
records.tagline: Your coding agent’s testing buddy
records.description: Checksum is an AI-native continuous testing platform for engineering teams shipping faster than manual QA can keep up. It generates, runs, and auto-heals end-to-end and API tests on every pull request, all as standard Playwright code in your own repo. When a test fails, Checksum tells you whether it found a real bug or a stale test, then fixes the false failures so your suite keeps pace with your coding agents.

records.name: Roveri
records.tagline: A riding journal for iPhone every ride, painted on a map
records.description: One tap records the route, speed, elevation and the weather of every ride, painted on a map. Rides add up into seasons you can re-open — and an atlas of every road you've ever ridden. A journal, not a navigator. Free to start; iPhone, iOS 18.6+.

records.name: MeetStream AI
records.tagline: Unified API & Infra for AI Meeting Agents
records.description: Agent-first infrastructure for meetings. One API to capture 50+ real-time data points from Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams, with built-in voice infrastructure so your agent joins as a participant, listens, speaks, and acts while the call is happening.

records.name: MiniMax Design
records.tagline: Your own agent team for open-ended creation
records.description: MiniMax Design is a desktop app that wraps MiniMax H3 in a full production workflow. Describe the video, and agents handle the brief, stills, H3 clips, music, and edit on one canvas. Skills, a 3D director stage, and ComfyUI nodes stay there when you want more control.

records.name: Revy
records.tagline: The ownership layer for fashion, shopping, and your wardrobe
records.description: Revy is the fashion app for recreating the looks you love, using the wardrobe you already own, while connecting inspiration, creators, shopping, and personal style.

records.name: Aloud
records.tagline: Turn spoken feedback into tasks your coding agent can run
records.description: Feedback is easier said than written. Aloud records your voice, your screen and a live transcript together while you talk through your app – pointing at things, changing your mind. Then one press: it rewrites the transcript into what you actually meant, asks about anything that could be read two ways, pulls the screenshots you were pointing at, and turns the session into tasks for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Whisper runs on-device – your audio and video never leave the Mac.

records.name: Lifelong
records.tagline: Your whole family’s health in one place.
records.description: Lifelong is the family health app built around the household, not just one person. Keep records, medications, symptoms, appointments, activity and sleep together for everyone you care about. Connect the wearables you already use, keep the right people in the loop, and use Alo, the in-app AI companion, to log updates and take simple actions. Sharing stays user-controlled. Available on iOS with a two-week free trial.

records.name: Hermai Brand API
records.tagline: White label your B2B SaaS with every customer's brand
records.description: A customer signs up with a work email or domain. You get back the logo, colors, description, and a ready to apply theme. Built for B2B SaaS so every customer's account looks like theirs from the first login. Free for 1,000 brands a month, every month. No card.

records.name: Grok 4.6
records.tagline: Frontier Intelligence for Long-Running Agents
records.description: Continuous reasoning meets real-world execution. Grok 4.6 brings major upgrades to agentic workflows, software engineering, and interactive web application generation—at an unchanged, cost-efficient rate of $2 / $6 per 1M tokens. Build long-running AI agent workflows with Grok 4.6 on xAI API and partner networks!

records.name: HyNote for Mac
records.tagline: Free local transcription that is 100% Private
records.description: Solving the three biggest pain points in meeting software: privacy, friction, and cost. By running speech-to-text entirely on-device, your confidential discussions never leave your hardware, ensuring total data privacy. It operates invisibly without sending an awkward bot into your attendee list, capturing system audio directly across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.

records.name: The New Calendly
records.tagline: Handle all of the work before, during, and after meetings
records.description: Meet Calendly Notetaker and Callie AI assistant: two new AI products built to handle the work before, during, and after meetings. Meetings are essential, but the work around them adds up fast. 😅 That's why we're launching an evolved Calendly. One that handles not just scheduling, but all of the work before, during, and after your meetings, so you can focus on what matters.

records.name: bitdrift.ai
records.tagline: The world’s first agentic mobile observability platform
records.description: bitdrift AI is the world’s first agentic mobile observability platform: a real-time, full-fidelity observability system that lets AI agents query mobile user behavior and act on it autonomously. It's built on the bitdrift Public API and bd skills. User journeys, performance metrics, and behavioral changes are all available when your agent needs them, not ten days later waiting for an app release. Early users of bitdrift AI report faster investigations and a 10x improvement in MTTR.

records.name: Berd
records.tagline: Weird, playful desktop app for building with AI agents
records.description: Berd is for people doing real work with AI agents inside a desktop workspace: engineers, product designers, and other builders who need a persistent agent companion that can use projects, skills, extensions, automations, model providers, and local workspace context. Users are often moving between broad product thinking and concrete implementation, so the interface needs to support fast chat, precise context selection, and confidence about what the agent can see or do.

records.name: NobodyWho
records.tagline: Run AI models on any device
records.description: NobodyWho is an inference engine for running LLMs fully on-device, built on llama.cpp. Open-source, free, no API keys, no cloud calls. We support Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, React Native, Python, and Godot. Includes type-safe tool calling with automatic grammar generation, multimodal input, Text-to-Speech & Speech-to-Text, GPU acceleration via Vulkan & Metal, and Hugging Face model downloads.

records.name: ProtoNote
records.tagline: Share AI-built prototypes, get feedback pinned to the page
records.description: Drop in an HTML prototype, image, or PDF and get a shareable link. Reviewers leave notes pinned to the exact spot on the page. No account required, just a name. Use the Claude connector to turn anything you build into a ProtoNote right inside the chat. When notes come in, tell Claude to pull them in and apply the changes. The new version publishes itself. Free tier includes 3 active prototypes with unlimited reviewers and notes. Reviewing is always free.

records.name: Cloudways Managed AI Agents

records.name: Glasp for Firefox

Highlight web articles, PDFs, and YouTube transcripts in four colors, add notes and tags, and summarize any page or video with ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Everything lands in one searchable library and exports to Notion, Obsidian, or Markdown. Sign in on any browser or on the mobile apps and your highlights follow you. Free, and nothing to migrate.

records.name: Peach Co-Pilot

records.name: Zoho Cliq 7.0

records.name: OmegleLite

What's different: fast WebRTC connections with no lag-heavy matching, dedicated chat rooms for 195+ countries so you choose who you meet, and a privacy-first design built from scratch, not bolted on. Built solo by a developer who wants random chat to feel safe and modern again.

records.name: Arcadely
records.tagline: Free browser games instantly, no download or signup needed
records.description: Arcadely is free browser gaming with zero friction: no downloads, no accounts, no app store. Two things make it different: multiplayer works by sharing a link (challenge a friend to Word Tiles, our Scrabble-style game, in one click), and games keep working offline once loaded it's perfect for subway commutes and spotty wifi. New games ship regularly.

records.name: The Success Blueprint

records.description: WHAT'S INSIDE: • 🌟 Vision & Life Direction • 🎯 Goal Setting & Progress Tracking • 🚀 Project & Action Planning • 📅 Monthly Calendar • ✅ Weekly Habit Tracker • 💪 Health & Wellbeing Check-ins • 💰 Finance & Savings Tracking • ✍️ Gratitude & Journaling • 💡 Ideas & Notes • 🔄 Weekly & Monthly Reviews Instead of simply making plans, use this planner to connect your vision → goals → actions → habits → progress → success.

records.name: HireYard
records.tagline: Equipment rental software that runs the whole yard
records.description: HireYard runs the whole rental operation on one screen: public booking widget with double-booking prevention, QR scan in/out on mobile, GPS asset tracking, pooled and quantity assets, maintenance scheduling by hours or service intervals, PDF hire agreements, quotes, invoices and Stripe payments, multi-location and multi-user access, revenue reporting with CSV and PDF export, and Zapier. Built for plant, tool and event & leisure rental operators. 21-day free trial, no card required.

records.name: CalcioCalc
records.tagline: 60 free calculators for AI, startup, marketing & finance
records.description: CalcioCalc is a free calculator hub covering AI cost estimation, startup metrics (CAC, LTV, MRR, burn rate), marketing (ROAS, CPC, CPA), and personal finance (EMI, SIP, compound interest). Every calculator includes a plain-English explanation of the formula, a worked example, and common mistakes to avoid — not just a bare input box. We also publish deeper guides behind the numbers. No signup, no paywall — just fast, clear answers for founders, marketers, and anyone doing quick math.

records.name: NayraTools
records.tagline: AI Tools for Amazon, Flipkart & Meesho Sellers
records.description: NayraTools is an all-in-one AI toolkit for e-commerce sellers on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho & Shopify. records.name: Binadox
records.tagline: One dashboard for cloud, SaaS and AI spend

Connect AWS, Azure, GCP or DigitalOcean and see spend by account, service and tag, with anomaly alerts and rightsizing recommendations. Automatic discovery finds the SaaS your team actually uses, tracks seats against active users, and flags renewals before they hit. Includes a Terraform cost tracker and an LLM tracker for OpenAI, Vertex, Azure OpenAI and Bedrock.

records.name: ShForm
records.tagline: AI-powered forms with logic, automation & security
records.description: ShForm is a form builder that helps you create powerful forms in minutes — no design or coding skills needed. Add conditional logic so forms adapt to each respondent, automate emails and data sync on submission, and keep everything secure with enterprise-grade protection. Manage and publish forms from web, iOS, or Android — anytime, anywhere.

records.name: PolyglotGym

Explanations adapt to your native language instead of being translated, and courses are free without signup. Web, iOS, and Android.

records.name: Zelcast Eng Scorer

records.description: Eng Scorer reads your LinkedIn the way a hungry, fast-growing startup actually would. Watch the dollars fly. There’s a live leaderboard of the top 100 working engineers (upvotes break the ties). The alumni page shows exactly where the talent is flowing and which companies keep producing the good ones.

records.name: Globerto
records.tagline: AI travel concierge that matches hotels to how you travel
records.description: Globerto is an AI-powered luxury hotel discovery and booking platform. Answer a few questions about your occasion, pace, and style. Instead of hundreds of undifferentiated listings, you get a shortlist matched to how you actually travel, with live rates and clear booking terms. Search by vibe ("overwater villas," "design hotels"), compare, and book in one place.

records.name: SoundTool
records.tagline: 61 free audio tools & 12 virtual instruments in 14 languages
records.description: SoundTool — free, browser-based audio toolkit with 61 tools and 12 playable virtual instruments. AI voice cloning, speech-to-text, text-to- speech, AI noise removal, hum-to-instrument, vocal tuner + trim, merge, convert, EQ, reverb, BPM and more. Every instrument records and exports WAV — no account, no upload, 100% client-side. 14 languages. Built by a solo developer on the Web Audio API. Zero data collection: your audio never leaves the browser.

records.name: Prune — Writing Clarity Editor
records.tagline: Cut the clutter from your writing and make every sentence.
records.description: Prune is a writing clarity tool designed to help you turn complicated, wordy writing into clear, concise communication. Paste your writing, identify unnecessary words and phrases, simplify sentences, and improve readability while keeping your original meaning intact. Key features: ✂️ Remove unnecessary words ✍️ Improve sentence clarity 🔎 Identify wordy phrases 📖 Improve readability 🎯 Keep the original meaning ⚡ Make editing faster 📝 Create cleaner, more professional writing

records.name: My Family Tree
records.tagline: The family tree your whole family can actually edit
records.description: Most family tree tools are built for genealogists digging through historical records. My Family Tree is built for the opposite problem: staying organized with the family you actually talk to. - Everyone can help build it - A real directory, not just names and dates - Time-boxed, view-only share links — send one branch to a cousin without giving them full access - Multi-script name support — type a name in English, see it rendered correctly in Gujarati/Hindi/etc.

records.name: Reel saver video and photo download
records.tagline: All-in-one video & photo saver, editor, and creator

records.tagline: Put your link here. Get discovered. Just free promotion.
records.description: CatHub is an interactive web experience featuring a fully responsive 3D animated cat that interacts with your clicks. The core concept is simple: users can submit their own links to claim available spots on the main canvas. Built with Vue 3, Spline, and Cursor AI, it includes robust modern features like bot protection (Cloudflare Turnstile + Honeypot technique) and full mobile optimization. Explore the canvas, submit your project, or just enjoy playing with the 3D cat!

records.name: A to Z Finance Management
records.tagline: Track money without handing your bank login to an app
records.description: Most finance apps make you hand over bank login credentials before they'll track a single rupee. A to Z Finance doesn't ask for that. Log expenses by pasting a bank SMS or UPI text, uploading a CSV/XLS statement, or typing manually — it reads Indian bank formats (tested against real HDFC statements) and auto-categorizes from your own history. Multi-user with real data isolation, no shared logins. Built by one person managing his own money, not a startup selling your data.

records.name: gin rummy super
records.tagline: casual games
records.description: Gin Rummy Super brings the classic card game to life with a fresh, competitive mobile experience. 🃏 Play exciting 1v1 matches, climb through different rooms and stakes, and enjoy special game modes that add new twists to classic Gin Rummy. records.description: Free Ideal Weight Calculator with 6 formulas, BMI, body fat %, frame size, BMI range, and weight tracking. Fast, accurate, private, and no sign-up required.

records.name: ScopeGuard Beta V0.2.1
records.tagline: Stop scope creep before it becomes unpaid work
records.description: ScopeGuard helps freelancers compare a client's new request against the original project scope before agreeing to extra work. Paste the agreed scope and the new request to identify likely scope creep, revisions, in-scope work, and conversational context. It also estimates additional work and helps draft a professional client response. This is an early free beta, and we're looking for real-world cases where ScopeGuard gets the decision wrong.

records.name: CoShareX
records.tagline: Fast paste, file share & multi-tool dev suite in one hub
records.description: CoShareX is a unified developer workspace that eliminates tab clutter. Instead of relying on fragmented, ad-heavy single-use sites, get fast pastebin sharing, seamless file uploads, and essential dev utilities in one lightweight hub. Features include client-side JWT decoding, multi-language code and JSON formatting/validation, fast data converters, and instant QR code generation—built for speed, privacy, and frictionless daily workflows.

records.name: ShortTrim
records.tagline: Turn long videos into engaging Shorts
records.description: Turn long videos into ready-to-post Shorts with AI. ShortTrim finds the best moments from lectures, podcasts, interviews, and more, then creates vertical clips with titles and descriptions. You can also generate AI prompts for custom backgrounds that match each clip's content and mood.

records.name: ScriptGrain - Write like you, at scale
records.tagline: AI writing that sounds like you. Measured, not guessed.
records.description: Every AI tool writes in the same confident, anonymous voice. Yours doesn't have to. ScriptGrain doesn't guess your style from a prompt: it measures 45 stylometric reference points from writing you've already done, holds every draft to those constraints, and scores each one against your profile. Miss the voice? A polish loop revises toward you, not generic-good. See your full profile free, no card. UK-built, UK English as standard, API + MCP server included.

records.name: Juvant Order Print Studio for Shopify

records.name: Fodcus:Focus & Feast

records.description: Unlike other Pomodoro timers, this app offers a more engaging mechanism. By simulating the process from "ordering" to "delivery," it makes focusing far less tedious. This timer also supports scheduling future sessions, reviewing past focus records, and customizing session names.

records.name: Sperio
records.tagline: An AI board of 8 agents that debates every S&P 500 stock

Valuations are computed in Python, not written by a model — and it prints n/a when the data can't support one. 10 free, no signup. It also screens on a full cycle: EV/EBIT against the median operating profit of up to 15 fiscal years, not the last twelve months.

records.name: Aristra AI
records.tagline: The AI Life OS that remembers and works so you don't have to
records.description: Most AI cares only about the outcome users want. Aristra cares about your process. It works alongside and for you across the things you already use, learning about you and from you, day and night. What works becomes a playbook it reaches for next time. What stops being true quietly fades. How you actually get things done is the most valuable thing about you, and it's the one thing no AI understands. One AI. One memory. Your life OS.

records.name: Choicease
records.tagline: AI-assisted structured decision-making tool
